rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the sun’s rays, light, or warmth.

example.english: There's sunshine today, so we don't need to bring an umbrella when we go out.
example.traditional: 今日有陽光，出街唔使帶遮喇。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 jau5 joeng4 gwong1 ceot1 gaai1 m4 sai2 daai3 ze1 laa3
